issues: The solution does not implement several core requirements: backup and restore functionality (src/lib/backup.ts, related UI and screens are missing), CSV and PDF export (src/lib/exportCsv.ts, src/lib/exportPdf.ts, ExportScreen, ExportButton are missing), app lock with Face ID/Touch ID (src/lib/appLock.ts, Settings to toggle lock are absent), adjustable mileage and tax rates in settings, tax estimation on the dashboard, backup encrypted with user-provided passphrase using scrypt, and the associated UI flows. The repository also lacks the files listed in the plan (e.g., src/lib/backup.ts, src/screens/BackupScreen.tsx, src/screens/RestoreScreen.tsx, src/lib/crypto.ts exists but backup logic is missing). These missing components mean the app is incomplete relative to the task description, even though the current acceptance tests pass.

feedback": "Please complete the missing features per the task requirements, ensuring all listed files exist and function correctly, and add corresponding unit and integration tests. Once the full feature set is implemented and passes all tests, the verdict can be changed to approve.
